text:
The Flyers ended a three-game winless run (0-2-1) in Vancouver, and the Canucks stretched theirs to six games without a win (0-6-0). Travis Sanheim put it out of reach with a shorthanded goal at 19:01 of the third, an unassisted wrist shot that made it 3-1.

Philadelphia scored early and held on. Michael Bunting beat Leevi Merilainen 2:03 into the game, and Travis Konecny added a power-play goal in the second. Matvei Michkov, the seventh pick in 2023 who arrived from SKA St. Petersburg, had an assist on Konecny's goal and was named first star. Christian Dvorak, drafted 58th overall by the Coyotes in 2014, set up two goals, and Joseph Woll turned aside 18 of 19 shots.

The shape of the game was closer than the score. Our expected goals, a measure of the quality of chances, finished PHI 3.13, VAN 2.26, and our deserved-to-win figure, the share of simulated replays each team wins, put it at 50-50. Philadelphia controlled the first two periods, then Vancouver took the third, out-chancing the Flyers 1.64 to 0.39 in expected goals. Lekkerimaki scored on the power play to make it 2-1, and Bunting's 37% look in the third was stopped by Merilainen. Woll saved 1.3 goals more than his shots deserved, and that gap decided it. For a Vancouver team that went 1 for 5 on the power play, the third-period push showed life, but it still has no win in six.
